instruction.text: A TV is 1.6 metres wide and 0.8 metres tall. Which formula is needed to find its diagonal length?
Find the diagonal length of the TV. Give your answer to two decimal places.
A bench is 52 centimetres wide and 164 centimetres long. Which formula is needed to find its diagonal length?
Find the diagonal length of the bench. Give your answer to two decimal places.
A clock is 120 millimetres wide and has a diagonal length of 242 millimetres. Which formula is needed to find its height?
Find the height of the clock. Give your answer to two decimal places.
An ice cube is 6 centimetres wide and has a diagonal length of 8.5 centimetres. Which formula is needed to find its height?
Find the height of the ice cube. Give your answer to two decimal places.
